description: This file provides Norwegian Nynorsk localization settings for the jQuery UI datepicker plugin, defining labels and formats specific to this language.

methods.name: datepicker.regional.nn
methods.description: An object containing localization strings for the Norwegian Nynorsk language, including month names, day names, and interface labels.

methods.name: datepicker.setDefaults
methods.description: Sets the default localization for the datepicker to Norwegian Nynorsk.
